# Java Edition protocol/Slot data

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.21.8`  
> Protocol version: `772`  
> Source: [Java Edition protocol/Slot data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Slot_data?oldid=3156505)  
> Revision: `3156505` (`2025-09-17T01:25:13Z`)  
> Retrieved: `2026-08-04T16:00:27+00:00`  
> License: [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)

The **Slot** data structure defines how an item is represented when inside an inventory window of any kind, such as a chest or furnace.

This page presents the new Slot data structure, using structured components. You can find the documentation of the old structure, that utilizes raw NBT data, [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Special:PermanentLink/2768623 "Special:PermanentLink/2768623").

# Hashed Format

Similar to [the usual slot format](https://minecraft.wiki#Format), but with the notable difference that data component values are encoded as CRC32C (note: CRC32C is not the same thing as CRC32) checksums. The way the checksum is generated is currently undocumented. It's currently only used in the [click container](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Packets#Click_Container "Java Edition protocol/Packets") packet.

| Name | | Type | | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has Item | | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | | Every following field is only present if this value is true. |
| Item ID | | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | | The [item ID](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_data_values#Blocks "Java Edition data values"). Item IDs are distinct from block IDs; see [Data Generators](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Data_Generators "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Data Generators") for more information. |
| Item Count | | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | | The item count. |

See [Structured components](https://minecraft.wiki#Structured_components) for more detail. | |
| Component data hash | [Int](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Int "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | A CRC32C (note: CRC32C is not the same thing as CRC32) checksum of the component data. Currently undocumented. |
| Components to remove | Component type | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Prefixed Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | The type of component. ## Other types

Common types used in multiple components are described below.

### Block Predicate

Describes a predicate used when block filtering is necessary. It can be parameterized to account for any combination of the type of block, the values of specific block state properties, or block entities' NBT data or data components.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blocks | [Prefixed Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [ID Set](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:ID_Set "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | IDs in the `minecraft:block` registry. Present only when tied to specific types of blocks. |
| Properties | [Prefixed Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Prefixed Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") of [Property](https://minecraft.wiki#Property) | See Property structure below. Present only when tied to specific properties of blocks. |
| NBT | [Prefixed Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:NBT "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| Data Components | [Prefixed Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") of [Exact Data Component Matcher](https://minecraft.wiki#Exact_Data_Component_Matcher) | A list of [data components](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_component_format "Data component format") which must exactly match the target block. |
| Partial Data Component Predicates | [Prefixed Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") of [Partial Data Component Matcher](https://minecraft.wiki#Partial_Data_Component_Matcher) | A list of predicates to match the block's data components. Max length = 64. |

#### Property

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Name | [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Name of the block state property. |
| Is Exact Match | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Whether this is an exact value match, as opposed to ranged. |
| Exact Value | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Value of the block state property. Only present in exact match mode. |
| Min Value | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Minimum value of the block state property range. Only present in ranged match mode. |
| Max Value | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Maximum value of the block state property range. Only present in ranged match mode. |

#### Exact Data Component Matcher

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | ID of the data component as listed in the table of data component types above. |
| Value | [Structured Component](https://minecraft.wiki#Structured_components) | Value of the data component. |

#### Partial Data Component Matcher

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Type of predicate. 0: damage, 1: enchantments, 2: stored\_enchantments, 3: potion\_contents, 4: custom\_data, 5: container, 6: bundle\_contents, 7: firework\_explosion, 8: fireworks, 9: writable\_book\_content, 10: written\_book\_content, 11: attribute\_modifiers, 12: trim, 13: jukebox\_playable. |
| Predicate | [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:NBT "Java Edition protocol/Data types") Compound | [Data component predicate](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_component_predicate "Data component predicate") encoded as an NBT compound tag. |

### Potion Effect

Describes all the aspects of a potion effect.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type ID | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | The ID of the effect in the `minecraft:mob_effect` registry. |
| Details | Detail | See Detail structure below. |

The Detail structure is defined as follows:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amplifier | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| Duration | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | -1 for infinite. |
| Ambient | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Produces more translucent particle effects if true. |
| Show Particles | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Completely hides effect particles if false. |
| Show Icon | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Shows the potion icon in the inventory screen if true. |
| Hidden Effect | [Prefixed Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") Detail | Used to store the state of the previous potion effect when a stronger one is applied. This guarantees that the weaker one will persist, in case it lasts longer. This section is missing information about: This behavior seems to be entirely server-sided. Does the presence of this field actually has any noticeable impact on the client?  Please expand the section to include this information. Further details may exist on the [talk page](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Talk:Java_Edition_protocol/Slot_data). |
